prompt_summary: Three identical chibi mole upper-body frames on clean magenta: curious open-eyed mole-up, happy squeezed-eye mole-booped, and laughing open-mouth mole-giggle, all flat-cut at the waist.
key_colour: #FF00FF magenta, absent from the mole palette
post_processing: Selected the second generation after visual inspection removed divider lines and stray marks.
tools/art/build-moles.ts crops the three 800px source columns, keys the magenta with 22% fuzz, trims, scales into 320x320 transparent frames, and packs a Pixi-compatible 960x320 atlas.
Chroma key is removed with border-connected transparency; visible edge despill is limited to the keyed alpha edge by the ImageMagick transparent operation.
Rebuilt twice with identical output hash.

owner_review.note: The frames read as one friendly mole with readable expression changes; the in-hole composite shows the lower cut and rim relationship at all five calibrated scales.
